objectives: This course aims to provide students with practical work experience in the corporate or social sector through a summer internship. The course also aims to help students connect their academic learning with real world practice, develop professional competencies, and enhance their understanding of how sustainability and social value are incorporated into organizational activities and decision making.
content: The course is conducted primarily through a summer internship in a company, foundation, social enterprise, or other relevant organization, subject to approval by the program. Students will participate in the regular work and activities assigned by their host organizations and gain direct experience of organizational operations and workplace practices. Through the internship experience, students will develop practical skills, professional awareness, and a broader understanding of the roles of the corporate and social sectors in contributing to sustainable development.
